title: Colimit-preserving presheaf extensions have the Kan mapping property on intermediate full subcategories
statement:
Use the universes, quasicategories and coherent functor mapping spaces of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones]. Fix universes $\mathcal U\in\mathcal V$. Let $D$ be a $\mathcal U$-small quasicategory, put $\mathcal P(D)=\operatorname{Fun}(D^{\mathrm{op}},\mathcal S_{\mathcal U})$, and let $y:D\to\mathcal P(D)$ be $d\mapsto\operatorname{Map}_D(-,d)$. Let $E\subseteq\mathcal P(D)$ be any replete full subcategory containing the essential image of $y$, with $y_E:D\to E$ the induced functor. Let $Z$ be a quasicategory admitting all $\mathcal U$-small colimits and let $H:\mathcal P(D)\to Z$ preserve them. For every coherent functor $G:E\to Z$, restriction along $y_E$ induces an equivalence of spaces
$$\operatorname{Map}_{\operatorname{Fun}(E,Z)}(H|_E,G)\xrightarrow{\ \sim\ }\operatorname{Map}_{\operatorname{Fun}(D,Z)}(Hy,Gy_E).$$
This equivalence is natural in $H,G$ and in restriction to any other intermediate full subcategory. Thus every transformation $Hy\to Gy_E$ has a contractible space of extensions $H|_E\to G$, including all coherent compatibility homotopies. In particular the identity on $Gy_E$, after an identification $Hy\simeq Gy_E$, determines such a comparison transformation. No colimit preservation by $G$ and no closure of $E$ under colimits is assumed; $E$ may be large relative to $\mathcal U$.
